bio: A soba shop well stocked with vegetable cuisine in season. From the varied and extensive menu, choose an assortment of small items as well as vegetable dishes, and cap the meal with the soba of your choice. The surfeit of options can be bewildering but of course you can order soba one plate at a time. If you arrive at lunchtime, set menus of rice dishes await you as well. Seasoned staff serve with practiced skill and grace, welcoming you like a local no matter when you visit....
